start: Signed in as the owner; member page of a member with no membership yet

steps.action: Tap "Sell membership" (top of the page, or the button in the empty "No memberships yet" card)
user_sees: Sheet titled "Sell membership"
Boxes "Plan", "Starts on", "Plan price", "Joining fee", "Received now"
Under Received now: "Leave blank if they will pay later. It will show in Dues."
must_not: A plan picked from another gym or branch
The sheet opening with money already typed

steps.action: Pick a plan, type the money in "Received now", pick "Paid by", tap "Confirm"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…" and cannot be tapped again
Sheet closes
Toast "Membership saved. Receipt <number>."
must_not: Two memberships or two receipts from two fast taps
Cash saved as UPI
A receipt for more than was typed

steps.action: Look at the member page
user_sees: Memberships card shows the plan with its first and last day
Payments card shows the new receipt number, day and way paid
Dues tile shows the balance with "Still to pay", or "—" with "Fully paid"
must_not: Dues, price and receipt that do not add up
The member still shown as "No membership yet."

start: Signed in as the owner; member page of a member whose plan is running (button reads "Renew")

steps.action: Tap "Renew"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Renew membership"
"Starts on" is filled with the day after the current plan ends, with the line "The day after their current plan ends (<day>)."
must_not: A start day that overlaps the running plan
The title "Sell membership" for a renewal

steps.action: Type a price above the plan price and tap "Confirm"
user_sees: A question about the higher price shows once
Button now reads "Yes, save"
must_not: The sale saved at the higher price with no question
The question shown again after "Yes, save" with nothing changed

steps.action: Tap "Yes, save"
user_sees: Toast "Membership saved. No money taken yet." when Received now was blank
The plan line reads "renewed till <day>"
must_not: The old plan cut short
Dues missing the new plan's price

start: Signed in as the owner; member page of a member who owes money (Dues tile shows an amount)

steps.action: Tap "Collect payment" at the top
user_sees: Sheet titled "Collect payment"
Boxes "For which membership", "Amount received", "Paid by", "Reference (optional)", "Received on"
Under the amount: "Leave blank to collect the full amount due."
must_not: The button shown for a member with no dues
A cancelled membership offered in "For which membership"

steps.action: Type a part of the due and look at the line under the form
user_sees: "Still due after this: <amount>"
must_not: "This clears all dues on this membership." for a part payment

steps.action: Tap "Save payment"
user_sees: Button reads "Saving…"
Toast "Payment saved. Receipt <number>."
Dues tile goes down by the amount
must_not: Two receipts from two taps
The payment put on another membership
Cash taken after the member already paid the same due online

start: Signed in as the owner; Collect payment sheet open for a member who owes money

steps.action: Type an amount above the due and tap "Save payment"
user_sees: Red line "That is more than the <amount> due on this membership."
Sheet stays open
must_not: A receipt above the due
Dues shown as a minus figure

steps.action: Type 0 and tap "Save payment"
user_sees: "Type an amount more than zero."
must_not: A zero receipt that uses up a receipt number

steps.action: Set "Received on" to a day in the future and tap "Save payment"
user_sees: A red line refuses the date; nothing is saved
must_not: A receipt dated ahead of today
A cleared date box shown as "Not a YYYY-MM-DD date:"

steps.action: Close the sheet; open "Sell membership" in a gym with no plans
user_sees: "You haven’t created any plans yet. Add a plan first, then you can sell it here."
must_not: An empty Plan list with a Confirm button that does nothing

start: Signed in as the owner; member with no dues, so no "Collect payment" button shows

steps.action: Sell a membership and leave "Received now" blank
user_sees: Toast "Membership saved. No money taken yet."
Dues tile shows the full amount with "Still to pay"
Button "Collect payment" now shows at the top
must_not: A receipt made for zero
"Fully paid" on the Dues tile

steps.action: Tap "Collect payment", leave the amount blank, tap "Save payment"
user_sees: "This clears all dues on this membership." before saving
Toast "Payment saved. Receipt <number>."
must_not: Less than the full due collected from a blank amount

steps.action: Look at the page again
user_sees: Dues tile "—" with "Fully paid"
Button "Collect payment" is gone
Membership row reads "Paid"
must_not: The Collect button still shown with nothing due
The member still on the dues list

steps.action: Sell a membership with money received, then open the receipt from the Payments card
user_sees: Receipt opens as a page to print with this member's name and amount
The sale and the receipt are saved under the person who is signed in
must_not: Another staff member's name saved as the person who took the money
The receipt or the member's phone number reachable by another gym
The price a member paid shown to other members

Received on and Starts on start from the device's today; staff may go only some days back

title: An owner checking a workout code is told "The owner gives the extra days." when the member has no gym plan to add days to
what: After a good workout code, the owner normally gets a "Give extra days" button. If the member has no gym plan that is not cancelled (for example only a personal training pack, or a cancelled plan), the button is left out and the owner reads "The owner gives the extra days.", the line meant for front desk staff. The owner is the owner, so the line sends them nowhere and does not say that a plan is missing.
expected: An owner sees the real reason, such as that this member has no plan to add days to and one must be sold first.
how_often: each time a workout code is checked for a member with no gym plan that can take days
fix_line: Give the owner their own line that says there is no plan to add the days to
